description.zh: 期望获取可缩容节点的数量。
description.en: The expected number of removable nodes to retrieve.

description.zh: 是否忽略实例状态，默认为false。
description.en: Specifies whether to ignore the instance status. Default value: false.

description.zh: 需要缩容的节点类型。**WORKER**表示热节点，**WORKER_WARM**表示冷节点。
description.en: The type of nodes to scale in. **WORKER** indicates hot nodes. **WORKER_WARM** indicates warm nodes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch get-suggest-shrinkable-nodes --instance-id es-cn-nif1q9o8r00080000 --node-type WORKER --count 1 --ignore-status false --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun elasticsearch GET /openapi/instances/es-cn-nif1q9o8r00080000/suggest-shrinkable-nodes --region cn-hangzhou --count 1 --nodeType WORKER --ignoreStatus false --header "Content-Type=application/json"
